main_text: A Pole living in Madrid and a creative and detail-oriented Frontend Developer with a unique foundation in architecture and design. I’m a self-taught developer who’s been exploring the world of web development for the past few years — learning, experimenting, and building along the way. I love creating web experiences that are clean, eye-pleasing, and full of personality.
extra_text: In my free time, I enjoy climbing, playing video games, creating art (mainly watercolor) and spending time with my cat, Cebula (Onion in Polish). If you'd like to find out more about me, don't hestitate to send me a message!
